english.title: Parent knowingly child not attending failed to ensure regular attendance at school
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being the parent of a child, namely **(..SPECIFY CHILD'S NAME..), aged **(..SPECIFY AGE..), and knowing that

(A)_[he]_
(B)_[she]_

was failing to attend regularly at the school at which

(C)_[he]_
(D)_[she]_

was registered as a pupil, namely **(..SPECIFY SCHOOL..), failed without reasonable justification to cause

english.legislation: Contrary to section 444(1A) and (8A) of the Education Act 1996.
